name: buctogai
text: buctogai is a variant spelling of boctogai, the Irish word for the fairy folk of the sea. MacKillop records this entry only as a one-line cross-reference, with no independent article body. The full record of the boctogai word-article, including the related phrase bunadh beag na farraige, sits under the headword boctogai, and readers should follow that entry for the main definition and the wider family of sea-fairy names.
